subject: biology

A: Style is clearly paper-collage: watercolour sky wash, torn grass strips, kraft board with taped polaroids (s02), ransom-tile headlines on grid/mustard/ink tiles, F7F9FC science tags with die-cut borders and washi tape (frames s02_00357, s03_00631, s04_00375).

Sync checked in video.mp4: 'air' 11.44 (card absent at 11.24, fading in at 11.39, landed by 11.94); 'glucose' 32.46 (C6H12O6 term appears at 32.41); 'forty' 48.54 (pie fading in at 48.49). The equation builds term by term on its words and the sheet holds through the recap and outro.
s04 middle zone actually explains: CO2 cloud, pot with H2O tag, glucose pie with data-driven 40% wedge and 72/180 tag, all 50+ px; QA 10/10 pass, A7 match_ratio 1.0, 1 render warning.
B: Style barely reads as paper-collage: flat vector shapes on a plain cream vignette, no torn strips, washi tape, textures or ransom tiles. Headlines are plain bold sans (s01 'Where does its material come from?', s04 headline wraps with an orphaned 'air', frame s04_00359).

Sync is accurate at the cue level: 'wood' 10.24 (faint at 10.19), 'air' 13.36 (faint at 13.31), 'reaction' 30.28 and 'forty' 57.72 both start on t0-0.05. But the whole equation pops at once on 'reaction' instead of building with its words.

Large empty areas: below the ground line (y≈1270-1920) is blank cream in every scene; the s01 middle zone holds only a tiny sprout from 1.0 to 4.5 s; the outro (≈62.7-68.2 s) is an empty middle zone with only the disclosure plate. The s03 H2O tag butts into the equation card. QA 10/10 but A7 0.989 with diffs, 3 warnings.

reason: A is recognisably the paper-collage style, builds the equation word by word with sync just as accurate as B's, and leaves about half as many empty middle-zone seconds; B is a generic flat layout with plain-text headlines and a 5 s blank outro.
